title: Inputs dealt to participants
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\iota$ be an index type. Given a value function $v:\iota\to F$ and, for each index, a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$, the dealt input for index $x$ and nonzero participant $i\in F$ is the share of $v(x)$ obtained from that polynomial by the $k$-participant vector sharing scheme over $F$.
hypotheses_covered: a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$ for each index
